title: Moment gap and sharp moment bound
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $P$ be a probability law on $\Omega$, let $X:\Omega\to\mathbb R$, and let $r,l$ be nonnegative integers with $r>0$ and $l\le r$. Then $\binom{2r}{2l}(2r-1)^{-l}\mathbb E_P[X^{2l}]-\binom rl\le0$ if and only if $\mathbb E_P[X^{2l}]\le(2r-1)^l\binom rl/\binom{2r}{2l}$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
